<thought>We need to determine how many aromatic carbon atoms are present in the unknown compound. The most direct way is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool, then count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic region (≈120–150 ppm). This will give the number of distinct aromatic carbon environments, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
